definition.en: Expert groups are specialized committees constituted by the Government of India to define, measure, and refine the methodology for identifying the poverty line in the Indian economy.
definition.hi: Expert groups are specialized committees constituted by the Government of India to define, measure, and refine the methodology for identifying the poverty line in the Indian economy.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding these groups is crucial for GS-3 as they form the basis of social welfare policy and resource allocation. UPSC frequently tests the evolution of poverty estimation methodologies and the shift from calorie-based to multidimensional approaches.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding these groups is crucial for GS-3 as they form the basis of social welfare policy and resource allocation. UPSC frequently tests the evolution of poverty estimation methodologies and the shift from calorie-based to multidimensional approaches.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the evolution of poverty estimation methodologies in India.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the evolution of poverty estimation methodologies in India.

learningOutcomes.en: Evaluate the shift from consumption-based to multidimensional poverty assessment.
learningOutcomes.hi: Evaluate the shift from consumption-based to multidimensional poverty assessment.
